IA No. 13599 of 2024, an application under Section 301(2) of CrPC moved on behalf of complainant seeking permission of this Court to assist the prosecution in the matter is taken up, considered and allowed for the reasons mentioned therein.
Shri Arshad Ali, learned Counsel appearing for complainant along with his Associates is permitted to assist the prosecution in the matter.

This first bail application has been filed by the applicant under Section 438 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant, who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.440 of 2024, registered at Police Station Bahodapur, District Gwalior for offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 312, 294, 323 and 506 of IPC.

As per the case of prosecution, prosecutrix, aged around 25 years, submitted a typed complaint dated 19-06-2024 to SHO, PS Bahodapur, District Gwalior that she got friendly with Mukesh Gaud (applicant) on face-book.
Mukesh proposed to marry her.
She started living with Mukesh as wife since 2017-18.
Mukesh sexually assaulted her on 14-12-2018 and promised to marry her when he gets his job.
Mukesh had sexual relation with her on the pretext of marriage.

When she got pregnant,
Mukesh gave her abortion pills.
When she created pressure on Mukesh for marriage, Mukesh refused to marry her and informed that he is already married.
Mukesh expelled her from his house and threatened to kill.

On such allegations, PS Bahodapur registered FIR at Crime No.440 of 2024 for offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 312, 294, 323, 506 of IPC against the Mukesh Gaud vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184128859/

sentences.text: Statements of the prosecutrix were recorded under Section 161 and 164 of CrPC.
Investigation is underway.
Learned Counsel for the applicant, in addition to the grounds mentioned in the application, submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this matter.
It is a case of consensual relationship between two adults.
When relationship turns sour, false allegations of rape are made against the applicant.
Learned Counsel submits that applicant is aged around 30 years.
He is in private service.
He has family to look after.
He is sole bread earner of the family.
There is no likelihood of his absconsion leaving his family, home and job.
There is no likelihood of his tampering with evidence by the applicant.
He is ready to cooperate with the investigation.
Therefore, applicant may be extended the benefit of anticipatory bail.

Per contra, learned counsel for State ably assisted by learned counsel for the objector opposes the anticipatory bail application on the ground of gravity of alleged offence and cites criminal history of three cases are against the applicant.
In reply, learned Counsel for the applicant submits that three cases are lodged against the applicant by the same complainant.
In one of matters, parties 3 MCRC-26904-2024 have settled the dispute amicably and the applicant stands acquitted in case of compromise.
Other two matters in relation to Crime No. 22 of 2021 and Crime No. 498 of 2020, PS Jhansi Road are pending for trial.
Applicant has never been convicted for any offence.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

Considering the arguments advanced by both the parties and overall circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant.
Thus, the application is allowed.

Accordingly, it is directed that in the event of arrest of applicant, applicant- Mukesh Gaud shall be released on bail in relation to Crime No.440 of 2024, registered at Police Station Bahodapur,
District Gwalior for offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 312, 294, 323 and 506 of IPC,
upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the same amount to the satisfaction of the Officer making arrest, for compliance with the following conditions: (For convenience of understanding by accused and surety, the conditions of bail are also reproduced in Hindi as under):-
(1) Applicant shall make himself available for investigation as may be directed by the officer, in-charge of investigation;
